title: A folded scalar whose lines are all blank is empty, whatever the width of the lines
notes: With no indentation indicator the content indentation is that of the first non-empty line; if there is none it is the number of spaces on the longest line (section 8.1.1.1). The three lines have 1, 2 and 3 spaces, so the indentation is 3 and every line is an empty line (production 166). The comment at column 1 ends the scalar. The value is the empty string. Compare yaml-test-suite S98Z, where a comment indented by one space is the first non-empty line and the wider blank lines before it are an error.

provenance.reference: A reader that took the indentation from the parent and read the wider blank lines as content, giving a value of line breaks and spaces.
